scoring_justification: Full recomputation of the atomistic simulation pipeline is infeasible for the verifier sandbox; comparing the agent's reported final energies to the paper's published values with tolerances is the appropriate scoring method.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for all fields in final_results.json, plus structural range checks.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Section 4.2.2 (ni1 constriction formation energies 6.30, -1.45, total 4.85 eV; ni2 3.05, -0.70, total 2.35 eV), Figure 10 and Section 4.2.4 (interaction energy at 21b ~ -0.06 eV), Section 4.2.5 and 4.2.3 (activation energy for Cu at zero stress 1.17 eV and at 0.00045μ 0.95 eV). Ratio and range from paper discussion (Cu cross-slip energy 1.07-1.28 eV, Ni(1)/Ni(2) ratio ~2.06).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Numbers extracted directly from the paper's reported results and scaling relationships.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact quantities the paper reports or derives; each gold value is traceable to a specific section/figure of the source paper.

outputs.description: Computed cross-slip energies, constriction formation energies, and activation energies for Ni(1), Ni(2), and Cu.

output_contract.notes: All energies must be scalar floats in eV. The checker compares these values to hidden gold values from the source paper with tolerances.

steps.description: Score the nine energy fields against hidden gold values with tolerances and two structural ratio checks. Each sub-check contributes equally to the step score (11 checks total).
